derivation.coordinate_permutation_generalization: For recipient i and donor j!=i, displacement is e_i-e_j.

necessity_boundary: Affine conservation + elementary recipient event + integer completion layer alone do not identify the unresolved transverse q values. The D6 re-derivation uses the already-frozen transverse exchange-symmetric half-state construction. Removing that symmetry reopens nonidentified pre-collapse decompositions; this is distinct from Stage-N ad hoc minimality.
premises: transverse exchange symmetry for the unresolved pre-collapse construction, hence dx*=dz*=-1/2
completed displacement coordinate layer C=Z inherited from the integer displacement module
completion-neighbor BRC legal endpoints PREV_Z(-1/2)=-1 and NEXT_Z(-1/2)=0
why_six_not_more: Once q=-1/2 is fixed and C=Z is the completion layer, each transverse coordinate has exactly the two legal neighbors {-1,0}; conservation permits exactly one -1 and one 0. Three recipients times two donors gives six.
